subject: Project Sirocco kickoff — MathWriting as a first-class benchmark
body:
Team,

Starting Project Sirocco — our internal codename for the MathWriting effort, please tag docs and dashboards with it.

Goal: make the MathWriting dataset (digital inks of handwritten mathematical expressions from the prompted collection) a first-class benchmark in our platform, with loader code, a reference recognizer, and a leaderboard slice in Evalline.

Milestones inside the 04-06 to 06-29 window:
- 04-24: ingestion of the full 2.9 GB mathwriting-2024 archive plus the excerpt archive for CI smoke tests.
- 05-22: reference model trained; performance metric from the example-code notebook wired into Evalline.
- 06-19: benchmark page live for internal teams, before the Q3 OKR lock on 06-26.

Alina owns staffing; Efe is tech lead. One open legal question on the data license — I'll raise it with Kofi separately.

Dmitri
